contact_cutoff.notes: Computational contact threshold for the V0 representation fixture only. It is not a measured molecular-contact cutoff.

accessibility_clearance.notes: Geometric nearest-neighbour clearance threshold for the V0 fixture. It is not biochemical accessibility.

ensemble.notes: Three deterministic synthetic Phase 3B conformations spanning the configured mixed-radix domain. Population statistics describe only this explicit index set.

tensor_network.notes: A tensor-network candidate is admitted only if exact reconstruction and a material computational/storage reduction are both established.

notes: Phase 5 V0 representation configuration. All thresholds and ensemble choices are explicit computational assumptions and cannot promote the V0 model.
